Open the letter
A letter from the developer
Hello,\nI'm the developer of 1 Day 1 Diary 👋

I imagine many of you ran into frustrations while using the app. So I rebuilt it **from scratch**. Now **your photos are backed up too**, and there are other useful features.\n\nTo keep updating it, I've added ads and paid features. In return, I make you these two promises.
From SeoJuNyang
